name: MakeDeez
original_description: Explore personalized photo gifts, custom clothing, prints, and accessories with MakeDeez. Compare real products, prices and sizes before uploading artwork. Preview your uploaded photos or ChatGPT-generated images on T-shirts, hoodies, canvas, blankets, stickers and more. Choose colors, sizes, print placement and quantity. Continue to secure checkout as a guest, or connect your MakeDeez account to save designs and reuse them later.
